# ScriptTaskInput

[API index](../index.md)

Awaitable keyboard and mouse actions for one running HTN task.
Use `await task.Input.KeyPress(...)` inside a `World.Tasks.Define` body to wait for the action.
For direct input without an HTN task, use `World.Input`; its commands return no promise.

Only one task operation may be pending. Held keys and mouse buttons are released when the task
is interrupted or ends. Resuming the task does not press them again.

**@keywords**

task, input, keyboard, mouse, holds
